description: This Java class defines a 'DailyCompoundingPeriod' used to calculate interest over a daily period for savings accounts. It manages end-of-day balances and computes interest based on those balances, supporting compounding interest calculations within a specified date interval.

classes.name: DailyCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: A class representing a daily interest compounding period, encapsulating the interval and end-of-day balances, with methods to compute interest and access the period interval.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a DailyCompoundingPeriod for a given date interval, filtering relevant end-of-day balances up to a specified interest calculation date.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest over the period based on the end-of-day balances and the specified interest parameters, supporting daily compounding.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval for this compounding period.
